title: Advances in chiral analysis: from classical methods to emerging technologies
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01202J, Tutorial Review
Open Access

Roberto Penasa, Giulia Licini, Cristiano Zonta
Chirality's impact across sciences has driven development of methods for fast, reliable enantiomeric excess determination. This review covers available methodologies, from traditional to modern, focusing on recent advances, their pros and cons, and research trends.
